correctness.rationale: Detailed ancestry proof: no two-step re-excitation for q>=4, hence every excitation history is a simple tree path of at most diameter three. A final excitation at time three is necessary and sufficient for extinction at q+2. The two mutually exclusive oriented histories have verified q^a-(q-1)^a and q^b-(q-3)^b+(q-1)^b-(q-4)^b factors. The limiting 2/q² probability is exact by normalization. Python exhaustive and separately written C++ integer enumeration agree in 14 and 8 parameter cases, with the latter checking the pointwise iff condition.
